data.narrative:
AtmoCooling is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Paul Mahacek and Paul-Emmanuel Herve, having raised $3.6M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes 8 private peers (Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, Enovix among them) and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though narrow peer matching at identical stage and valuation tier yielded insufficient datapoints for robust median-based valuation.

The Stage-Progression method, calibrated to typical Seed-to-next-stage step-ups, applied a 2.5x multiplier to the $3.6M raised as a valuation proxy, yielding $9M. The Peer-Median method was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum thresholds (need ≥3 datapoints; found 0 in narrow filters). This single-method triangulation carries material uncertainty.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $8M to $10M, with a median point of $9M. Key uncertainties include the absence of tight peer comparables at Seed stage in climate tech, which limits confidence in stage-progression multiples, and the undisclosed nature of AtmoCooling's prior or concurrent funding dynamics. Additional data on comparable Seed rounds in atmospheric or thermal technologies would materially refine this estimate.
